item.title: WATCH- J&K’s Auqib Nabi demolishes Karnataka; dismisses Rahul, Karun and Smaran for cheap in Ranji Trophy final

J&K captain Paras Dogra won the all-important toss and decided to bat first. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- Wasim Akram’s heart-breaking expressions as Pakistan near elimination as they lose to England
item.description: Legendary Pakistani pacer Wasim Akram and ex-captain Ramiz Raja had sadness in their eyes in commentary box as they saw Pakistan lose to England in their recent Super 8s game of the T20 World Cup 2026. The match was played on February 24 in Pallekele Stadium, and England won it by 2 wickets to become the first team to qualify for the semis. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity reacts as South Africa’s big win over West Indies keeps India’s semi-final hopes alive
item.description: South Africa registered a dominant nine-wicket victory over the West Indies in their T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 clash at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on Thursday (February 26). Opting to bowl first, the Proteas reduced the Caribbean side to 83/7 in the 11th over. However, Jason Holder (49 off 31) and Romario Shepherd (52* off 37) added 89 runs for the eighth wicket to propel the West Indies to a competitive 176/8 in 20 overs. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity reacts as India keeps semi-finals hopes alive; defeats Zimbabwe by 72 runs
item.description: India defeated Zimbabwe by a huge margin to keep their hopes of the T20 World Cup 2026 semi-finals alive. The two teams had faced off in a Group 1 Super 8s game at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai on February 26, 2026. Sikandar Raza won the toss and chose to field first. India brought in Sanju Samson for Rinku Singh and Axar Patel for Washington Sundar. Samson gave an electrifying start to India with 24 in 15 balls with one four and 2 sixes, adding 48 runs in 3.2 overs with Abhishek Sharma.
